_description: Canonical failure status payload published to the install MQ by report_on_fail (install/app/tfa/watchers.py) and consumed by the stacker MQ listener (stacker/src/console/commands/mq/listener.rs). Mirrored to install/tests/fixtures/deploy-failure-payload.json and stacker/tests/contracts/deploy-failure-payload.contract.json for CI.

example.message:
Deployment has been paused. Error: fatal: [203.0.113.10]: FAILED! => {"msg": "non-zero return code", "rc": 1, "stderr": "...Bind for :::8082 failed: port is already allocated"}
A port this stack needs is already in use on the target host (often by another already-deployed stack, e.g. statuspanel). Free the port or change it in stacker.yml, then redeploy.

available_options.err_description: A port this stack needs is already in use on the target host (often by another already-deployed stack, e.g. statuspanel). Free the port or change it in stacker.yml, then redeploy.

available_options._notes: error_kind is the stable machine-readable id of the class selected by classify_error() (install/app/tfa/exceptions_mappings.py). err_description is human remediation text and may change freely; consumers must switch on error_kind, never on err_description text.

_compat: Stacker versions before error_kind ignore unknown fields in available_options. Payloads before this contract omit available_options entirely — consumers must treat its absence as 'unclassified' (error_kind: internal_error) and may fall back to text parsing of message.
